dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped annular structures with dark outer perimeters transitioning to lighter centers; edges show high-frequency noise and non-uniform thickness.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid dark-pixel clusters; primarily located in the interstitial regions between the macro-annuli and as small central points within some rings.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the mid-lateral surface form an obtuse triangle; additional smaller annuli posterior to this formation create a linear chain-like geometric sequence.
